# proxmox_node_apl_download (Resource)

Downloads an appliance template through `POST /nodes/{node}/aplinfo` and waits for the worker.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_node_apl_download" "tpl" {
  node     = "pve-1"
  storage  = "local"
  template = "alpine-3.24-default_20260803_amd64.tar.xz"
  triggers = { gen = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)
- `storage` (String)
- `template` (String)
- `triggers` (Map of String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `upid` (String)
